packageRules.description: chalk 5 is ESM-only, and the plugin is published as CommonJS
ESLint 10 requires Node.js >=20.19, but unit tests still run on Node.js 18 to cover the published packages' supported engines. Keep eslint and @eslint/js aligned on v9 until #595 drops Node.js 18

Babel 8 requires Node.js ^22.18.0 || >=24.11.0 and is ESM-only, but unit tests still run on Node.js 18 and 20 to cover the published packages' supported engines. Keep Babel on v7 until #595 drops them
eslint-import-resolver-node 0.3.10 and later use resolve 2.x, which no longer resolves relative imports when the directory of the linted file does not exist

tsup 9 requires Node.js ^22.18.0 || ^24.11.0 || >=26 and fails with ERR_REQUIRE_ESM on Node.js 18, where the test-node-versions job builds the packages before running their unit tests. Keep tsup on v8 until #595 drops Node.js 18 and 20

TypeScript 6 breaks the dts build of tsup 8, which sets the deprecated baseUrl option (TS5101), and tsup 9 waits for #595. TypeScript 7 has no compiler JS API, which tsup and typescript-eslint need, and typescript-eslint supports typescript <6.1.0
@boundaries/config validates rule options as ESLint does, with ajv 6 and the draft-04 meta schema, and ESLint 9 and 10 depend on ajv 6

pnpm 11 requires Node.js >=22.13, and the test-node-versions job installs and runs the workspace with pnpm on Node.js 18 and 20. Keep pnpm on v10 until #595 drops them. pnpm 12 is a rewrite that needs a manual migration

Development runs on the Node.js of .nvmrc and @types/node follows its major. The test-node-versions job already covers Node.js 26, so moving development to it also replaces 26 with 24 in that matrix. Keep both on v24 until #595 changes the matrix
packages/website commits font files copied from these packages
prBodyNotes: Run `pnpm --filter website sync:fonts` and `pnpm --filter website social-card`, and commit `packages/website/static/fonts/` and `packages/website/static/img/og-image.png`.

packageRules.description: support/eslint-config turns off the rules of the sonarjs recommended config that the SonarCloud profile does not run
prBodyNotes: Check `SONARJS_RULES_NOT_IN_SONARCLOUD` in `support/eslint-config/index.js` again against the recommended config of the new `eslint-plugin-sonarjs` version and the "Sonar way comprehensive" profile of SonarCloud.
